about: Finlex, the Finnish government's free legal database (statutes, Statute Book, translations and Supreme Court case law). This CLI searches all datasets, lists Statute Book entries and Supreme Court precedents, and fetches statute, translation and precedent detail pages and translation PDFs.

commands.summary: Keyword search across all Finlex data (legislation, government proposals, treaties, case law, officials). Returns hit count, category counts and hits as a Next.js server-action text stream.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page. The UI offers 10, 20 or 50. Use 0 to get only the total and per-category counts.

commands.summary: List the latest statutes published in the Statute Book, as shown on the Finlex home page.
Get a statute by number and year, e.g. 55/2001 (Employment Contracts Act). Returns the title and statute text.

params.name: number
params.description: Statute number within the year, e.g. 55. Some numbers have a suffix, e.g. 39-001 for the Criminal Code (1889).

commands.summary: Get the English translation page of a statute by year and number, including the translation PDF link.

params.name: number
params.description: Statute number within the year, e.g. 55

commands.summary: List the Supreme Court material collections (precedents, rulings other than precedents, etc.) with last-update dates.
List the latest Supreme Court precedents (KKO).
Get the full text of a Supreme Court precedent by year and number, e.g. KKO 2026:74.

params.name: number
params.description: Precedent number within the year, e.g. 74
